name: Entrance to the Soul
source:
You awaken in a decaying apartment block that should be familiar but isn’t. The building is endless, looping, and alive. 

Two strangers are trapped with you: Mila, fearful and fragile, and Maria, skeptical but cunning. The building shifts depending on your choices, feeding on trust, memory, and fear.

[From [url=https://zarudnev.itch.io/entrance-to-the-soul]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在一座破旧的公寓楼里醒来，你应该很熟悉，但其实并不熟悉。这座建筑是无尽的、循环的、充满活力的。

两个陌生人被困在你身边：米拉（Mila），害怕而脆弱，玛丽亚（Maria），多疑但狡猾。建筑物会根据你的选择而变化，以信任、记忆和恐惧为食。

[来自[url=https://zarudnev.itch.io/entrance-to-the-soul]Itch.io[/url]]
